mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_change_log (tenant_id, resource_type, resource_id, operation_type, before_data, after_data, changed_fields, operator_id, operator_name, request_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{operationType}, #{beforeData}, #{afterData}, #{changedFields}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{requestId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, resource_type, resource_id, operation_type, CAST(before_data AS CHAR) AS before_data, CAST(after_data AS CHAR) AS after_data, CAST(changed_fields AS CHAR) AS changed_fields, operator_id, operator_name, request_id, change_time FROM system_change_log WHERE ORDER BY change_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
